priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore listener removal in the cleanup callback
findings.body: Every cleanup callback now leaves its message handler registered. Disposed consumers therefore continue receiving messages, and repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate handlers, causing duplicate processing and unbounded listener retention.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current full diff shows src/socket.ts:3 replaces `socket.off("message", handler)` with an empty disposer, so cleanup still fails to detach the registered listener.
